description: React component for a chat interface, managing chat state, rendering messages, handling user input, and integrating with backend services for chat data and AI responses.

methods.name: loadUserChats
methods.description: Loads chat history from local storage for a given user ID.

methods.name: saveUserChats
methods.description: Saves current chat history to local storage for the current user.

methods.name: createNewChat
methods.description: Creates a new chat instance, optionally with an initial message, and triggers AI response if applicable.

methods.name: handleStartChat
methods.description: Starts a new chat with a given initial message.

methods.name: handleSelectChat
methods.description: Switches to a selected chat by ID.

methods.name: updateChatTitle
methods.description: Updates the chat title based on the first user message.

methods.name: handleAIResponse
methods.description: Generates AI response for a given user input in a specific chat.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles user message submission, updates chat state, and triggers AI response.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Logs out the user and resets chat state.
